entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, get me an agent. I need to make a return.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. I understand you're calling about a return. Can I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Alex Smith. Order number is VF-77491. I need to return the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. Just tell me how to do it.

Okay, Alex, I have your order pulled up. It was delivered 17 days ago. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me a bit more? What specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. It works fine, I just don't need it. Can I return it or not?
Understood. One moment while I review the policy for this item.
Look, it's a simple yes or no. I don't have all day.

I appreciate your patience, Alex. I've just confirmed. Since your VeloBand Cadence Sensor was delivered 17 days ago, it is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you now.

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next five minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for your VeloFit products?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
